method: Each of 71 frozen gzip summary shards was verified and loaded in place through the actual app serializer and current catalog filter worker. Only sparse encounter reference rows were retained for independent exact-count and matrix comparisons.
ordinalPolicy: App inputs are Unix-day ordinals (1970-01-01=0); the worker alone converts to the statistics Gregorian-day epoch.
limitations: This validates counts and integration, not the truth of reported encounters or biological types.
Source-event identity and narrative classification are pinned and reviewed by the source builder; summary joins verify event ID, collection, chunk and detail index.
Reports remain the counting unit; source collection overlap does not establish independent incidents.

storage.receiptRetention: Retain as the bounded current encounter runtime QA receipt; summary shards and sparse source evidence remain canonical in their original locations.
